rules.read_only_parser: replay+regression may establish replay support; specialist approval required before Phase 13 promotion
rules.diagnostic_rule: replay+challenge+specialist canary+hardware proof required before specialist approval
rules.verification_requirement: replay+challenge+hardware proof required before specialist approval
rules.dangerous: never automatic and never promoted by the read-only workshop

truth_boundary: Software may validate lifecycle and hashes. A hardware_supported transition requires a real external hardware-proof hash; tests exercising the validator do not create hardware certification. TTG promotion is finalized by Phase 13, not by Phase 11.
